title: The Press Isn't Great
text: The Press Isn't Great. In this set, two pieces are good. The silver bar and the silicone tube are excellent. The bar gets garlic and onion smells off your hands. Just wash you hands with the bar. The tube is great for peeling garlic. Pop a clove in, roll it on the counter, and then just pour the garlic out. It is also easy to clean. The press, well, I'm not a fan. The plastic just isn't strong enough to really press the garlic firmly. The cover also gets in the way. I'm not a fan of that part of the set.

description: This Farberware 3 Piece Garlic Set includes: a garlic press, a garlic peeler, and a rub-a-way bar. All the essentials you need to add garlic to your favorite food. Use the garlic press to easily crush and mince garlic by placing cloves into the head and pressing the handles together. Use the rub-a-way bar to eliminate smelly odors by rubbing the stainless steel bar between your hands with or without water. Effortlessly remove outer shell of garlic by placing cloves into the peeler and rolling back and forth. Press features built-in cleaner that pushes out garlic peels for easy cleanup. All items are dishwasher safe. Lifetime Limited Warranty.
